name: token-tally
description: See your Codex usage and turn it into a personal card to save or share.

interface.shortDescription: Your Codex usage in a card
interface.longDescription:
See your Codex activity in a beautifully designed card. Get your lifetime token count, busiest day, current activity streak, and longest agent turn, then save the image or share it wherever you like.
Just install and ask, “@tokentally What’s my tally?” Token Tally uses the account already signed in on your computer. There is no separate Token Tally account, and your statistics are not sent to the developer or shared automatically.
Works on a computer, or from your phone through a connected computer. First use may download a rendering tool to create the card. Some accounts may not provide usage statistics, and the totals may not include all your ChatGPT conversations.
defaultPrompt: Check my token usage and export a share card.
Decode the record mark on this Token Tally card.
